questions.instruction: 选择这个词在技术讨论中的意思。
options: 算法
数据表
法律条款
用户画像

questions.prompt: The algorithm was tested for bias before it was used in hiring.
questions.audio: The algorithm was tested for bias before it was used in hiring.
questions.answer: 这个算法在用于招聘前接受了偏见测试。
options: 这个算法在用于招聘前接受了偏见测试。
这个算法在招聘后才被设计出来。
招聘人员拒绝测试算法的准确性。
算法只被用于安排培训课程。
questions.translation: 这个算法在用于招聘前接受了偏见测试。

questions.prompt: 听研究员说明系统如何处理数据。
questions.instruction: 注意被动动作和时间顺序。
questions.audio: Personal data is processed only after permission has been recorded.
questions.answer: 只有记录了许可后，个人数据才会被处理。
options: 只有记录了许可后，个人数据才会被处理。
个人数据处理后才会请求许可。
个人数据永远不会被处理。
系统会公开所有个人数据。
questions.translation: 只有记录了许可后，个人数据才会被处理。

questions.prompt: 透明度对于建立用户信任非常重要。
questions.answer: Transparency is essential for building user trust.
questions.audio: Transparency is essential for building user trust.
questions.translation: 透明度对于建立用户信任非常重要。

questions.prompt: The model _____ by an independent panel last month.
options: was reviewed
reviewed
is reviewing
has review
questions.audio: The model was reviewed by an independent panel last month.
questions.translation: 该模型上个月由独立小组进行了审查。

questions.prompt: 配对人工智能伦理中的词语。
questions.translation: 算法、透明度、歧视、偏见、审计、监督

options: 歧视
偏差
隐私
创新

questions.prompt: A clear explanation was provided whenever an automated decision affected a user.
questions.audio: A clear explanation was provided whenever an automated decision affected a user.
questions.answer: 每当自动化决定影响用户时。
options: 每当自动化决定影响用户时。
只有系统完全没有影响用户时。
只有用户关闭账户后。
只有人工决定被取消时。
questions.translation: 每当自动化决定影响用户时，都会提供清晰的解释。

questions.prompt: 听产品负责人解释公平检查。
questions.audio: The fairness report was published so affected users could challenge the result.
questions.answer: 发布公平报告是为了让受影响的用户质疑结果。
options: 发布公平报告是为了让受影响的用户质疑结果。
发布报告是为了阻止用户查看结果。
用户会替代团队撰写公平报告。
公平报告只记录服务器速度。
questions.translation: 发布公平报告是为了让受影响的用户质疑结果。

questions.prompt: The training data _____ for missing groups before release.
questions.instruction: 选择现在完成时被动结构。
options: has been checked
has checked
was checking
is check
questions.audio: The training data has been checked for missing groups before release.
questions.translation: 发布前，训练数据已经被检查是否遗漏群体。

turns.speaker: ethics
turns.text: The model performs well overall, but its error rate is higher for older applicants.
turns.translation: 这个模型整体表现不错，但对年长申请人的错误率更高。

turns.speaker: engineer
turns.text: The training data will be rebalanced before the next test.
turns.translation: 下一轮测试前会重新平衡训练数据。

turns.speaker: ethics
turns.text: Good. The revised results must be published with a clear explanation.
turns.translation: 很好。修订后的结果必须和清晰的解释一起发布。

tasks.prompt: What will happen before the next test?
tasks.answer: The training data will be rebalanced
options: The training data will be rebalanced
The model will be used for hiring immediately
The revised results will be deleted
